category_title: Individuals with SIB masking social functions under standard assessment conditions
minimal_context: The student is in a padded treatment room wearing canvas sleeves while the tutor presents an instructional task using a three-step prompting procedure.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time to work. Please sort these blocks into the bin.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Sits in the padded treatment room wearing canvas sleeves, looking away from the instructional stimuli.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Watch me do it. Pick up the block and put it in the bin like this.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Ignores the blocks and begins hitting his arms against his legs at a high rate despite the canvas sleeves.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let me help you. I am going to guide your hands to put the block in the bin.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Immediately begins hitting himself in the head, kicking his legs against his torso, and attempting to dig his nails into his skin.)
